curiosity.text: Match the attached reference images exactly in art style: hand-painted Japanese casual cel animation look, soft painted backgrounds with visible gouache texture, clean thin dark-brown character line art, warm natural light, gentle muted palette.

orders.prompt: Background, no people: a clear cold blue winter sky over the Florida coast in January 1986 seen from far away on the ground, a quiet beach and palm trees small in the foreground, and high in the sky a white rocket exhaust trail that splits into two curling forks of white smoke. Calm, distant, documentary mood.

Background, no people: a 1986 American university classroom in the morning, wooden desks in rows seen at an angle, a blank green chalkboard, tall windows with pale winter light, a wooden teacher's desk at the front left. Leave open floor in front of the chalkboard for standing people.

Background, no people: a 1986 American college dorm room, a small CRT television on a dresser with a dark screen, a bed, a desk with books, posters with no readable text, a window. Leave open floor in the center.
Background, no people: a 1986 college cafeteria in the morning, long tables with trays, a TV mounted high in a corner with a dark screen, windows. Leave the aisle in the foreground empty.

Background, no people: a psychology professor's office in 1988, a wooden filing cabinet with one drawer pulled open showing paper folders, bookshelves, a desk with a green lamp, window with bare trees. Leave open floor on the right.

Character model sheet of the SAME man: an American psychology professor in 1986, about 58 years old, receding grey hair, glasses, brown tweed jacket, knitted tie. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale, facing slightly right: (1) handing out a single sheet of paper with one hand; (2) holding a neat stack of paper sheets against his chest; (3) asking a question with an open palm, gentle face; (4) one hand on his chin, thinking.

Character model sheet of the SAME 20-year-old American college student woman in 1986: shoulder-length curly brown hair, big cream knitted sweater, jeans, sneakers. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on a simple wooden chair writing on a sheet of paper on a clipboard on her lap; (2) standing, hand on chin, looking up, remembering; (3) standing, confidently explaining with one open hand, a sure smile; (4) standing, holding a single sheet of paper in both hands, shocked wide eyes.

Character sheet of TWO 1986 American college students, same scale, four full-body poses side by side: (1) a young man with short dark hair and a plaid flannel shirt sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard; (2) a young woman with a blonde ponytail and a denim jacket sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard; (3) the same young man standing and talking with a confident gesture; (4) the same young woman standing with a confident shrug and a smile.

Prop sheet, three separate objects side by side: (1) a single sheet of lined paper with a few lines of handwriting in blue ink (scribbles, no readable words); (2) a neat stack of many such handwritten sheets held with a paper clip; (3) a wooden filing cabinet drawer pulled out, seen from the side, with paper folders inside.

Background, no people: a 1932 Cambridge University psychology room, dark wood paneling, a tall window with gothic stone college buildings outside, a wooden table with papers and a fountain pen, two wooden chairs. Leave open floor in the middle.
Background, no people: a misty river at dusk in a Pacific Northwest forest, dark pines on both banks, calm grey water, fog, a quiet empty riverbank. Mysterious old-tale mood.

Character model sheet of the SAME man: a British psychologist in 1932, about 46, dark hair neatly parted, small round glasses, grey three-piece suit. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale, facing slightly right: (1) reading aloud from a sheet of paper; (2) listening attentively with hands behind his back; (3) writing in a notebook; (4) raising one finger, making a point.

Character model sheet of the SAME 1930s Cambridge male student, about 20, slicked short hair, tweed jacket, sweater vest, tie. Three full-body standing poses side by side, same scale, facing slightly left: (1) retelling a story with both hands gesturing; (2) frowning, trying to remember, hand on forehead; (3) shrugging confidently.

Prop sheet, three separate objects side by side, each seen from the side: (1) a long carved wooden dugout canoe of the Pacific Northwest with simple painted patterns; (2) a small plain English wooden rowing boat with two oars; (3) a single old typed paper page with a title line (no readable text).

Background, no people: a 1970s university classroom set up for an experiment, rows of desks, a 16mm film projector on a cart at the back, a pull-down projection screen at the front that is blank white, venetian blinds half closed, dim light.

Extra wide background, no people, no vehicles: a side view of a 1970s American suburban intersection, an empty asphalt road running left to right across the whole frame, a crosswalk, a traffic light, low shops, trees, clear day.

Character model sheet of the SAME woman: an American psychologist in 1974, about 30, long straight dark hair, 1970s patterned blouse and a knee-length skirt. Four full-body standing poses side by side, same scale, facing slightly right: (1) gesturing to the side as if presenting a film screen; (2) asking a question, holding a sheet of paper; (3) writing notes on a clipboard; (4) pointing with a pen, explaining with a slight smile.

Character model sheet of the SAME 1970s American male college student: shaggy brown hair, striped shirt, flared jeans. Four full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on a simple chair watching something ahead, leaning forward; (2) sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard; (3) standing, nodding with certainty and pointing to the side as if he saw something; (4) standing, unsure, scratching his head.

Prop sheet, four separate objects side by side: (1) a red 1970s American sedan seen exactly from the side facing right; (2) a blue 1970s American sedan seen exactly from the side facing left; (3) a small scattered pile of shattered glass shards on the ground, sparkling; (4) a round analog car speedometer dial with only tick marks and a needle, no numbers.
Background, no people: a 1970s American indoor shopping mall, two levels, a round fountain, planters, shop windows with no readable text, warm lighting, a wide empty floor in the foreground.
Background, no people: a 1995 university interview room, a small table with two chairs facing each other, a cassette tape recorder and a booklet on the table, soft window light, plain walls.

Character sheet, same scale, four full-body poses side by side: (1) a 5-year-old boy in 1970s clothes (striped t-shirt, shorts) looking around lost and worried; (2) the same boy crying, rubbing his eyes; (3) a kind elderly woman in a flowered dress and cardigan bending forward and reaching out her hand; (4) a young mother kneeling and hugging the same boy, relieved.

Character sheet, same scale, four full-body poses side by side: (1) a 25-year-old man in 1995 (short hair, green sweater, jeans) sitting on a simple chair reading a booklet; (2) the same man sitting with eyes closed, trying to remember, fingers on his temple; (3) the same man standing and telling a story with his hands; (4) a woman interviewer in her 40s with a notebook, gently asking a question.

Background, no people: a vast old library interior, tall wooden bookshelves receding in many directions, rolling ladders, warm lamps, a long central reading table that is empty, dust floating in light beams. Leave open floor in the foreground.

Background, no people, no animals: a neuroscience laboratory in 2000, a clean bench with a small clear-walled test chamber box with a metal grid floor and a small speaker on its wall, a computer monitor, shelves with bottles, cool fluorescent light.

Prop sheet, five separate objects side by side: (1) a friendly hand-painted human brain seen from the side, soft pink, no labels; (2) a small glowing seahorse-shaped hippocampus model, warm gold; (3) an old library index card with a few handwritten lines (no readable text); (4) a thick red hardcover book standing upright; (5) a thick blue hardcover book standing upright.

Character sheet, four separate figures side by side: (1) a small white lab rat sitting calmly, sniffing, seen from the side; (2) the same rat crouched and frozen in fear, ears back; (3) a 35-year-old neuroscientist in a white lab coat (short dark hair, beard stubble) standing and writing notes on a clipboard; (4) the same scientist standing, looking surprised, holding the clipboard.

Prop sheet, three separate objects side by side: (1) a handwritten manuscript page with many lines crossed out and rewritten in different inks (no readable words); (2) a yellow wooden pencil with an eraser, lying diagonally; (3) a clean handwritten manuscript page with neat lines (no readable words).
Background, no people: a Korean city street on a fresh morning, a wide crosswalk, an unfamiliar new office building ahead, the sidewalk splitting into two paths, soft sunrise light.

Character and prop sheet, same scale, four separate items side by side: (1) a 28-year-old Korean office worker woman (short bob hair, beige trench coat, tote bag) walking to the right; (2) the same woman standing still, looking up, imagining something with a hopeful face; (3) the same woman standing and rehearsing a presentation with one hand raised; (4) an empty soft white thought cloud, hand-painted, with no text.

Background, no people: a 2001 American college student lounge, sofas, a large CRT TV on a stand with a dark screen, a coffee table with papers and pens, autumn light through the windows. Leave open floor in the center.

Character model sheet of the SAME 2001 American college student woman: dark straight hair in a low ponytail, grey hoodie, jeans. Three full-body poses side by side, same scale: (1) sitting on a simple chair writing on a clipboard; (2) standing, confidently describing a memory with both hands, eyes bright; (3) standing, hand on chin, unsure.

Prop sheet, three separate instant photographs with white borders, side by side, each slightly tilted: (1) a photo of a sunny campus walkway with a coffee cup on a bench (an ordinary day); (2) a photo of a small dorm kitchen with a radio on the counter; (3) a photo of a crowded student lounge with people gathered around a TV seen from behind (no screen content).
Background, no people: an empty 1980s American courtroom, judge's bench, witness stand, wooden railings, solemn afternoon light.
Background, no people: an empty prison cell, bars in front, a narrow bed, a small high window with a single beam of light, quiet and still.

Prop sheet, five separate objects side by side: (1) a photo lineup card with six small portrait frames showing only anonymous grey silhouettes, no faces; (2) a laboratory report sheet with a DNA band pattern image and lines of tiny unreadable print; (3) a closed manila case folder; (4) the same manila case folder with a big red stamp mark on the cover (no readable text); (5) a wooden judge's gavel lying on its side.

Background, no people: a warm Korean family living room in the evening, a low table with a notebook and a pen, a sofa, family photo frames on a shelf (faces too small to see), a window with city lights.

Character sheet, same scale, four full-body poses side by side: (1) a Korean mother in her late 30s (hair tied back, soft pink cardigan) kneeling down to a child's height, asking gently; (2) a 7-year-old Korean child in a yellow t-shirt talking with small hand gestures; (3) a Korean man in his 40s in a navy sweater, explaining his side with an open hand and a laugh; (4) a Korean woman in her 40s in a green blouse, shaking her head and laughing, pointing to herself.
Background, no people: a wooden desk at night under a warm lamp, an open notebook and a pen, a drawer slightly open with one old sheet of paper inside, dark window behind.
